verdicts.why: 'não' glossed 'not' is the negation inside 'não sabemos => we don't know'; the English renders it as the contraction "don't", so 'not' is a back-gloss.
'de que' => 'that' is a particle gloss of LEGO 'tem a certeza de que'; the seed target 'Are you sure you don't mind' has no 'that'.
'em' => 'in' is the preposition inside 'em conjunto => together'; the seed target 'work together' renders no 'in'.
'the name' is in the LEGO 'o nome dele => his name'; the seed target has 'his name', so the article is dropped/fused into the possessive.
'I'd like' versus seed "I wouldn't like": the same words are present but split by the negation, so there is no single correct contiguous value.
'o dia' => 'the day' glosses part of 'o dia todo => all day'; the seed target 'all day' has no 'the'.
'විදිහට' => 'way' is part of LEGO 'ඒ විදිහට => like this'; the seed target "It's like this" renders no 'way'.
'ඊයේ' => 'yesterday' matches its LEGO 'ඊයේ රෑ => last night', but the seed target says 'last night' so yesterday is a literal back-gloss.
'කරනවා' => 'do' is part of LEGO 'වැඩ කරනවා => will work'; the seed target 'will work' has no 'do', and the LEGO differs from the seed's verb.
The row matches its LEGO 'ඔහු ඕනේ නම් => even if he wants it', but the seed target says 'Even if he wanted to', so the LEGO disagrees with the seed.
The row matches its LEGO 'whatever he says', but the seed target is 'Whatever he says' and the row gloss is 'even if says something', so the gloss is a literal paraphrase.
'it doesn't need to be' differs from the seed's "it's not meant to be" and from its LEGO 'it's not meant to be easy', so a judgement call on the gloss.
The row 'don't think will lose' is a literal gloss of the LEGO 'I'm not planning to lose', and the seed target says "I'm not planning to lose".
'it's not like before' differs from the seed 'it's not far ahead now' and from its own LEGO, which also says 'far ahead'; the row is about its sentence.
'ගන්නයි' => 'to take' is part of LEGO 'නිවාඩු ගන්නයි => for holidays'; the seed target says 'for holidays', so the row is a back-gloss.
'a friend' versus seed 'an old friend': 'friend' is present but 'a' is replaced by 'an' and interposed by 'old', so there is no single forced value.
'මට' => 'me' is part of LEGO 'මට අවශ්‍යයි => I need'; the seed target 'Or if I need to improve' has no 'me'.
'want to take' differs from the seed's 'have to catch' and from its LEGO 'they have to catch'; ඕනේ is glossed 'want' where the seed says 'have to'.
'is getting weak' vs seed "he's getting weak": 'is' is contracted into 'he's', so the words are present but fused.
'කාලේ' => 'time' is part of LEGO 'දවල් කාලේ => all day'; the seed target 'all day' renders no 'time'.
